text: What two things did Metcalfe add to ALOHA to produce CSMA/CD?
choices: Listen before transmitting, and listen while transmitting to detect collisions
explanation: Carrier sense avoids starting into a busy medium and lifts utilisation from 18% to well over 90%. Collision detection aborts a doomed frame immediately rather than wasting its full duration. Neither is possible on a radio channel, which is why Wi-Fi uses collision avoidance instead.
